If I am living outside India, should I give fitra where I am living or I should give in India. 3.To whome I can give this amount.Can I give it to my relatives who are poor , to educational institute , or to any charity society. 7162 views Q. I found some money (1 note of Bangladeshi 500 Taka, equivalent to US $7) at the Masjid premise (that leads to the entrance/exit of the Masjid and Madrasa), on January 18, 2008. Instantly I enquired to few people like Muazzin, Khadem of Masjid and some labours whether they lost any money. They said 'NO'. I thought it was lost from any worker (Madrasa-construction work was going on ) and hence enquired my best but found no one claiming the money. Then I requested the Muazzin to make a decleration after Isha Farz Salaah among the Musallis regarding the lost money. He did so. But no one came or claimed. Then I asked a local Ulama regarding the matter and he replied, I should wait for 2 months. If in the mean time no one came to claim the money, I should give the money to poor people. 1 (one) month has already passed. I'm confused about what to do with that note. Please provide me answers for the following queries on the basis of the written matter: 1). Should I really wait for another 1 month (total 2 months) to find the owner of the money? 2). What other types of decleration should I make to find the owner? Should I make some posters and paste them on the Masjid building? 3). If I can give the money to the poor right now, waiting no further, Should I give all the money to a single poor man/woman or I can give among 50 people at same or more & less proportionate. 4). If someone asks me for a loan of 500 Taka, Can I give him that note of 500 Taka since it's in my pocket for long 1 month without being used , finding no owner? Inshallah I can give the same amount if the real owner claims the money after I give the money to someone as loan. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 31587 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Disbursement of zakat Question: Every year iam sending the zakat to a society operatesin India. The society operates school in muslim populated rural areas. Most of the students comes from a poor background who do not afford the expenses of education, therefore the society has called many people to come forward & sponsor the child. Every yr i collect the zakat & send to the person responsible for the school operation & in return iam getting a list of students with amount details that has been reimburse directly against their tution fee, books, uniform etc. The reimbursement is purely to the discretion of school and no money is being given to the student in their hand. Iam doing this since many years, however recently one of my friend told me that my zakat is not "ada" as the school is taking money instead of giving money directly to the student as the sole owner of the money who should be free to use it at his will. Please guide me in this regard, also advise on past transactions if iam wrong. Answer ID: 31587 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 838/544/H=1432) Your friend may be right if the zakah amount is spent with no regard to proper way of tamlik (giving in possession). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
